name: JSON Formatter
description: Beautify, validate and minify JSON with clear syntax errors. Runs entirely in your browser.

seo.title: JSON Formatter, Validator and Minifier Online
seo.description: Free online JSON formatter, beautifier, validator and minifier. Clear syntax errors, processed locally in your browser.

content.technical: Parsing uses the browser's native JSON parser. Valid input is validated before it is formatted or minified.
content.privacy: Your JSON never leaves your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
instructions: Paste your JSON, or click Example.
Click Format, Minify or Validate. Pick the indentation first if you like.
Copy the output. Errors show the line and column.
examples: Formatted: one value per line, indented.

faq.question: Is my JSON sent to a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.

faq.question: Are big numbers and key order preserved?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool reformats the text itself, so numbers like 12345678901234567890, key order and duplicate keys are kept exactly as written.

faq.question: Are comments or trailing commas allowed?
faq.answer: No. The tool follows strict JSON, so comments, trailing commas and single quotes are reported as errors.

faq.question: How are errors reported?
faq.answer: With the line, the column, the offending character and a short explanation in your language.
